stem: Which sentence from the article “Sticking To It” contains a SIMILAR idea about an object being used often?

options.label: A
options.text: It took them several more years to perfect the design, but finally, with the help of other scientists, they had it . . . (paragraph 7)

options.label: B
options.text: The men chose their company as a place to test their invention. (paragraph 8)

options.label: C
options.text: Their impact is undeniable—roughly 50 billion sticky notes are manufactured in the United States each year. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: Indeed, sticky notes may be the most valuable “mistake” in invention history! (paragraph 9)

visual_elements: My boat became a backyard fixture not on our pond but in our tree; there it sits steady, offering a tasty treasure of bird seed.
